messages.subject: CODEX and MIP data
messages.body_plain:
Dear Yuchao,

Can you tell me if CODEX is suited for samples sequenced by the means of MIPs (molecular inversion probes).
I'm interested in trying CODEX among other tools for detecting CNV's in the BRCA1 and 2 genes.

If so, do I need to make any modifications to the script to run the tool?

I hope to hear from you soon!

Kind regards,

Koen Hendriks

messages.subject: Re: CODEX and MIP data
messages.body_plain:
Dear Koen,

Sorry for replying a bit late but yes if I understand correctly, MIP is capturing based technology, followed by enrichment and sequencing. If this is the case, CODEX can be used. You need to provide it the bed file indicating the regions that are captured. Please refer to here for instructions https://sites.google.com/a/cornell.edu/yuchaojiang/home/research/codex. The R package in Bioconductor itself is for whole exome sequencing but we have a version for targeted sequencing — refer to the link above.

Cheers,
Yuchao
